title: lithocarpus pseudoreinwardtii
intro: Lithocarpus pseudoreinwardtii, commonly known as the Borneo tanamera tree, is a species of evergreen tree in the beech family, Fagaceae. The plant has been traditionally used in Southeast Asian medicine for its various health benefits, including its potential to treat fever, diarrhea, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Lithocarpus pseudoreinwardtii are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are thought to contribute to its ability to reduce inflammation, prevent infections, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
